Author: Karunesh Singh Pawar

Applicant :- Girjesh Kumar Yadav
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
Counsel for Applicant :- Pramod Kumar Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
1.Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State
and perused the record.

sentences.text: 2.Learned counsel for the applicant submits that in the gang chart, two cases have been shown against the applicant.
In both the cases, the applicant has been enlarged on bail.

In the first case, i.e.
first information report No.74 of 2022 under sections 302, 201 I.P.C., no specific role was assigned to the applicant and hence, he was enlarged on bail vide order dated 19.12.2022, Annexure-3.
In the other case crime No.414 of 2021 under sections 376-D, 323, 506 I.P.C., the applicant was falsely implicated via application under section 156(3) CrPC.

The allegations made in the first information report were not corroborated with medical evidence and the applicant was enlarged on bail by a coordinate Bench of this court vide order dated 12.5.2023 filed along with the bail application as Annexure-3 also.
Apart from these cases, there is no other case pending against the applicant.
The applicant is in jail since 26.2.2022.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that there is no possibility of the applicant of fleeing away from judicial custody or tampering with the witnesses.
In case the applicant is enlarged on bail, he shall not misuse the liberty of bail.
3.Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid facts as argued by the learned counsel for the applicant.

4.Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, and also considering the nature of allegations,
arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, for the period for which he is in jail and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I find it to be a fit case for enlarging the applicant on bail.

5.Let the applicant Girjesh Kumar Yadav, involved in Case Crime No.369 of 2022 under Section 3(1)
U.P. Gangsters & Anti Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986, P.S. Mahmoodabad, district Sitapur be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.

entities.text: U.P. Gangsters & Anti Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: (ii) The applicant will not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.

(iii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iv) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.

(v) The applicant shall also file an undertaking in terms of requirement of Section 19(4)(b) of U.P. Gangsters & Anti Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986 that he will not indulge in any case or misuse the liberty of bail.
